title: Prompt Engineering — Test Prompts Like Code
key_insight: Keep a versioned evaluation set with normal, edge, and adversarial cases. Compare prompt versions on quality, latency, and token use.
body:
## Test Prompts Like Code

A rewritten prompt fixes one example but breaks ten others. Judging from a chat window hid the regression.

Keep a versioned evaluation set with normal, edge, and adversarial cases. Compare prompt versions on quality, latency, and token use.

Avoid asking for hidden chain-of-thought. Request concise conclusions, supporting evidence, or checkable intermediate artifacts when reasoning transparency is needed.
common_mistakes: Longer prompts are always more reliable.
Requested JSON is guaranteed to parse without checks.
One successful chat proves a prompt cannot regress.
mini_exercise: Draw “Test Prompts Like Code” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Clear prompts improve reliability before more expensive retrieval, tuning, or model changes are attempted.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Test Prompts Like Code,” explain Prompt Engineering without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
